s5_excluded_consequences: Accidents in later operation requiring independent commissioning and operational assurance failures.

independent_rationale: S1: 2 — grid integration combines studies, protection and control design, coordination, physical connection, and technical testing; S2: 1 — Intermediate judgment: interconnection, equipment, and test cycles commonly take months to years rather than weeks or decades; S3 cost: 0 — connection changes and energized integrated tests require high-value equipment, grid access, and coordinated specialist work; S3 throughput: approvals, outages, and the single physical connection make decisive attempts scarce and serial; S4: 0 — equipment delivery, installation, outage windows, and physical connection floors dominate elapsed time; S5: 0 — protection or integration errors can damage equipment or compromise grid and facility safety; scope caveat: pilot demonstration connection only, not broader market diffusion or commercial-fleet rollout.
owner_rationale: Select S5=1. Protection or integration errors can damage equipment and disturb a shared network, but layered protection, staged energization and utility operating procedures normally limit the direct consequence. This is very low tolerance, not automatically catastrophic or irreversible.
